title: DCGAN

paper.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Networks
paper.year_note: Original/preprint year except GCN (2017 venue, 2016 preprint) and speculative decoding (2023 venue, 2022 preprint).

statement: Implement DCGAN: train MNIST convolutional generator and discriminator; audit classifier confidence and class diversity. Read the linked paper and isolate the named mechanism. Write a self-contained solve(data), fit using training tensors only, and return Submission(model=model). Keep validation labels out of fitting and preprocessing. This is an educational reduced-scale adaptation, not a claim to reproduce original paper results. Use mnist; required output: Noise -> images; discriminator returns real/fake logits. Evaluate generation_quality (maximize). Report frozen-classifier confidence and per-class diversity separately; no single proxy PASS. Required ablation: Remove generator batch normalization at fixed training updates. Curriculum draft: reference, task-specific objective/evaluation adaptation and thresholds remain unimplemented; a named dataset may have a loader but this does not make this model executable. The provided solution raises NotImplementedError.
